greet_refuses.text: You are not welcome at my counter. Go on.

greet_wary.text: I have my eye on you. Pay for what you take.

greet.text: Pierre Vasseur, general store. If we do not have it, the ferry might bring it on Thursday.

greet_friendly.text: Good to see you. The bread came in fresh this morning.

greet_regular.text: My best customer! I put a tin of the good coffee aside for you.

about_work.text: Tins, rope, batteries, cigarettes. Half the island comes through my door before noon. Pay at the till and do not lean on the glass.

about_ferry.text: Everything comes by the ferry. When the weather turns the shelves go bare, and everybody blames me.

about_town.text: Quiet, mostly. Since the new families came there is more bread to bake and more faces to learn.

replies.ferry: Where does your stock come from?
replies.town: How is the town these days?
